cases.name: Leslie Jo Robinson Mixon
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Jo was a fun-loving and caring daughter, sister, and aunt who had an undeniable connection to nature and all its beauty.  Watching the eagles soar, playing with her precious fur babies, and watching over her goats and other critters brought harmony to her life.  A feeling of warmth that could only be provided by God himself.  In return for such solace, she enjoyed working in her yard and planting trees for the squirrels to enjoy, whom she often referred to by name.  She was also a lover of Indian culture with an innate bond to the history and beauty of Indian customs and a special admiration for the artistic style.

Jo, affectionately called Jo-Jo, by her cousins, loved her family dearly.  She was a strong-willed, very protective “mother hen” to her baby sister and her beloved nieces and nephews, whom she spoiled beyond measure."
